title: The Face Sandwich
original: First take two piece of bread then get peanut butter and jelly and open the peanut butter jar and take your knife and take some peanut butter with the sharp side and put some on the face of the bread and open the jelly and put some on the other piece of bread on the face then put the jelly side with the peanut butter side.

steps.text: First take two piece of bread

actions.say: Two pieces of bread. They are in a closed bag, so I will take the whole bag!

steps.note: Read 'two piece' as 'two pieces'. The bag is closed, so both pieces mean the bag. The robot takes the bag.

steps.text: then get peanut butter and jelly
steps.note: Three things, two hands. The oldest thing (the bag of bread) goes on Chef Byte's hat.

steps.text: and open the peanut butter jar
steps.note: Opening needs a free hand. The hat is taken, so the jelly jar goes on the counter, then the lid comes off.

actions.say: My knife? Robots don't own knives. I will take this one.

steps.note: 'Your knife' read as the butter knife on the counter.

steps.text: and take some peanut butter with the sharp side

actions.say: Sharp side down. Scoop! I got a tiny line of peanut butter.

steps.note: Scooping with the thin edge only picks up a sliver.

steps.text: and put some on the face of the bread
steps.note: 'The bread' is still the bag (on the hat). 'Face' taken literally: Chef Byte draws a skinny peanut butter smiley face on the bag.
Hands are full again (knife and peanut butter jar), so the peanut butter jar goes on the counter first.

steps.text: and put some on the other piece of bread on the face
steps.note: No tool said for the jelly, so a hand. 'The other piece of bread' is still the bag, so a jelly face goes on the other half of the bag.

steps.text: then put the jelly side with the peanut butter side.

actions.say: The jelly side and the peanut butter side are both on the bag. Fold!

steps.note: Both faces are on the same bag, so the only way to put them together is to fold the bag in half.

missing: Open the bread bag before taking the bread.
Take two slices out and set them down (Chef Byte only has two hands).
Use the flat side of the knife to spread.
Say 'spread it across the top of one slice' instead of 'the face'.
Say what to use for the jelly (the knife).
Say to flip the jelly slice over onto the peanut butter slice.

fixes.text: Untwist the tie and open the bread bag.
Put the two slices of bread on the plate.
and take some peanut butter with the flat side
and spread it on the top of one slice of bread
and use the knife to spread jelly on the other slice
then flip the jelly slice over onto the peanut butter slice.

result: A folded bag of bread with a peanut butter face and a jelly face squished together, on Chef Byte's hat. The bread never left the bag.
